label: For every being x: if the esse of x is not limited, then x satisfies the primitive…, from own being
meaning: A being whose esse is not limited has its esse received in nothing, since received esse is limited (STMT-RECEIVED-ESSE-IS-LIMITED, q.7 a.2); so it is its own being (STMT-UNRECEIVED-ESSE-IS-OWN-BEING, q.7 a.1 with ad 3); and what is its own being is infinite (STMT-OWN-BEING-IS-INFINITE, q.7 a.1). A second derivation, following the order of the q.7 a.1 sentence, of the stated leaf STMT-UNLIMITED-ESSE-IS-INFINITE; it leaves that leaf's stating claim unchanged. All three premises stay open and are supported, not stated.
